'''Hoil''' was a [[Sunesi]] [[Gender/Legends|man]] who lived on [[Monor II]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was one of many of his world's citizens who followed King [[Agapos the Ninth]] in his underground resistance movement when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] began to occupy the planet.
